steps.stdout:
--api-key	API key; prefer KANEO_API_KEY, since a flag is visible in the process list
--api-url	Kaneo base URL (env KANEO_API_URL)
--human	force human-readable output, even through a pipe
--json	force JSON output
--project	project id (env KANEO_PROJECT)
--timeout	per-request timeout
--workspace	workspace id (env KANEO_WORKSPACE)
--assignee	user id to assign
--description	task description
--due-date	due date
--help	help for create
--priority	urgent, high, medium, low or no-priority (default medium)
--status	column id to create the task in (default to-do)
